harper: tiny announcement — we just hit 11,000,000 monthly inference requests and closed a strategic renewal. stunned and so grateful. :tada:
leo: WHOA. massive congrats team!! :rocket: :confetti_ball:
mina: this calls for sushi and a vinyl listening party in the kitchen. who's in?
ezra: in for sushi. also bringing my portable turntable (yes it's a thing).
harper: celebration-bot posted a confetti sticker in the thread :confetti_ball:
ops-bot: deployment 2026.03.27-4 completed to prod. health checks: green. P95 stable.
leo: poll: sushi platters 🍣 or espresso bar ☕? reply +1 sushi, +2 espresso
mina: +1 sushi (i can't refuse spicy tuna)
ezra: +2 espresso (i need legit crema to stay functional)
harper: poll so far: sushi 1, espresso 1. closing in 2h.
mina: shoutout to infra + docs for the smooth renewal handoff. also the onboarding playbook was golden.
leo: GIF drop: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-win-abc123
ezra: best moment: latency didn't spike during the traffic ramp. ops team is living legend status.
harper: drafting an announcement for #announcements: "11M monthly inferences + strategic renewal! Thank you to everyone who shipped, monitored, and supported customers. Snacks and a mini vinyl listening party in the kitchen at 3:30pm." feedback?
mina: add a line calling out the customer success team and the onboarding engineers who stayed late.
leo: i'll bring disposable chopsticks and napkins. ezra, do you have a playlist?
ezra: curated "victory spins" playlist ready. low BPM for respectful sushi chewing.
celebration-bot: scheduled a 15:20 reminder in #random: "Sushi + vinyl celebration for 11M milestone at 15:30"
mina: also tiny photo for socials? 3:45 quick group pic?
harper: yes, comms will want one. remote folks can join via Zoom at 15:35 for the toast.
leo: minor brag: my caffeine plant survived my neglect. clearly correlated with infra uptime.
ezra: GIF battle: https://giphy.com/gifs/dance-xyz789
mina: will there be stickers? i am emotionally invested in stickers.
harper: sticker request filed with swag-bot. also a small plaque idea for the kitchen: "11M monthly inferences — thank you teams." who signs?
leo: i'll sign. and i'll bring a tiny gold star sticker to mark the day.
ops-bot: reaction :tada: added by harper
mina: meeting-free hour after 4pm for decompress and extra record-scratch vinyls?
ezra: love that. see you at 15:30 in the kitchen or on Zoom. couldn't have done it without everyone <3
harper: next goal: 15M. for now, sushi and spins. thank you all.
